title: EU NdFeB permanent-magnet research feasibility mass balance
units: magnet mass in metric tonnes unless otherwise stated; elemental shares are mass fractions; REE output is not magnet mass
method: Source-linked bounded research feasibility envelope based on Rizos et al. (2022) modelled selected applications. No probability is assigned. Demand and secondary supply are scenario outputs; yields are chain-level scenario outcomes, not plant recovery yield or observed throughput. This is not a forecast and not proof of exact 30% sufficiency.
scope: Selected application cohorts in CEPS analysis, modeled as approximately 68% of overall EU NdFeB magnet market in 2020; incomplete application coverage means neither demand nor recycling share is whole-EU comprehensive.

identityChecks.secondarySupplyShareDefinition: secondary magnet mass / selected-application magnet demand × 100%; use model-reported scenario envelope rather than multiplying theoretical EOL potential by a fabricated yield
identityChecks.calculation: 10 kt / 36 kt × 100 = 27.78%; source rounds to about 27%, small difference attributable to rounded reported inputs
identityChecks.elementToProductWarning: Tonnes of separated oxide, contained element, magnet blocks, used magnets, ore or concentrate are not interchangeable.
